name: Tally Prime with GST
overview: The Tally Prime with GST course provides practical training in computerized accounting, GST, and business transactions using Tally Prime.
description: The course is designed for students, commerce graduates, accountants, business owners, and job seekers who want practical accounting skills using Tally Prime.
eligibility: Open to anyone interested in learning computerized accounting using Tally Prime.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of accounting is helpful but not mandatory.

duration.note: Course duration varies. Please contact the academy for details.

fees.note: Please contact the academy for the latest fee details.

teaching_methodology: Personalized teaching with practical accounting exercises and individual attention.
study_material: Comprehensive study material is provided according to the course requirements.
faculty: Highly qualified and experienced faculty members provide practical accounting training.
learning_outcomes: Create and manage companies in Tally Prime

faqs.question: Will I learn GST in this course?
faqs.answer: Yes. GST is included as part of the Tally Prime course.

faqs.question: Which version of Tally is taught?
faqs.answer: The course covers Tally Prime and also references Tally ERP 9.

faqs.question: Does the course include payroll?
faqs.answer: Yes. Payroll management is part of the syllabus.

faqs.question: Will I learn inventory management?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inventory creation and management are included.

faqs.question: Is TDS covered?
faqs.answer: Yes. TDS is included in the course.

faqs.question: Will I learn company creation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Company creation is one of the core topics.

faqs.question: Is practical training provided?
faqs.answer: Yes. The course emphasizes practical accounting using Tally Prime.

faqs.question: Who can join this course?
faqs.answer: Students, commerce graduates, accountants, business owners, job seekers, and working professionals can join.

faqs.question: How can I know the course duration and fees?
faqs.answer: Please contact the academy for the latest duration and fee details.
